title: dllhost.exe crash every time Powertoys is being updated to later versions
author: yagamikira88
summary: During upgrades, dllhost hosting PowerToys context-menu packages hangs, extending setup time and in one report contributing to an Explorer shell restart.
next_action: Reproduce an in-use context-menu package upgrade and correlate installer sequencing with dllhost quiesce.

confidence.rationale: The repeated signature is strong, but installer lifecycle instrumentation is still needed to identify the faulty transition.

judgment.rationale: Three version ranges and two context-menu packages show the same MoAppHang signature, including a current 0.95.0 to 0.100.2 per-user upgrade.
evidence: PowerRename and Image Resizer context-menu packages both appear in upgrade-time dllhost hangs.
The same hang signature 463a / 2097152 is reported across multiple upgrades.
The newest report supplies Event 1002 timing and a current per-user MSI upgrade path.
Current installer sequencing unregisters context-menu packages during removal and terminates PowerToys processes during setup, making lifecycle ordering the relevant maintainer test area.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce an in-use context-menu package upgrade and correlate installer sequencing with dllhost quiesce.

fix_assessment.rationale: The failure is reproducible, but public evidence does not prove whether package unregister, COM host quiesce, Explorer restart, or process termination ordering is the faulty step.

issue_context.summary: During upgrades, dllhost hosting PowerToys context-menu packages hangs, extending setup time and in one report contributing to an Explorer shell restart.
known_information: The issue occurs during auto-update or MSI upgrade rather than ordinary context-menu invocation.
Both PowerRename and Image Resizer packages have been observed.
Reverting the classic-context-menu registry tweak did not eliminate the issue.
inferences: Replacing or unregistering an in-use sparse context-menu package may be involved, but the exact installer transition is unconfirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The newest Event Viewer evidence makes a maintainer reproduction more useful than another reporter request.
initial_investigation: Inspected current Product.wxs context-menu unregister/cleanup and process-termination sequencing.
Compared all three public hang reports in the thread.

actions.label: Reproduce context-menu upgrade hang
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Upgrade while context-menu packages are hosted by dllhost
reproduce.module: Installer / PowerRename / Image Resizer / File Locksmith
prerequisites: Per-user PowerToys install with at least one context-menu module enabled
setup: Invoke the enabled context menu so its package is loaded before upgrade.
steps: Start an in-product or MSI upgrade to the current stable release.
Measure time spent around package unregister/removal and observe dllhost.
Collect Application Hang and shell-restart events with timestamps.
Repeat with each context-menu module disabled to isolate package-specific behavior.
reproduce.expected_result: Upgrade should complete without a dllhost MoAppHang or Explorer shell restart.
